talents.description_en: Increases the maximum Soothe stack limit for all targets based on Talent level.
When attacked, consumes Soothe stacks to reduce total DMG received.
When at max Soothe, survives fatal DMG and then removes all Soothe stacks.
When at max Soothe, greatly increases Action Mana.
Greatly increases the Soothe stack limit; when Soothe exceeds a threshold, it counts as max Soothe.
When casting skills, increases Soothe stacks based on the number of allies.
When at max Soothe, increases the amount of Soothe stacks dealt.
After applying Soothe, causes enemies to lose Mana and allies to gain Mana.
Grants herself Soothe based on Toughness lost by both sides.
On the first turn, all targets cannot inflict non-Instant statuses except Soothe.
After Cleanse, grants herself Toughness and increases her Toughness limit.
Increases total DMG dealt based on current Toughness.
Increases Cleanse stacks dealt, with an extra effect against Debuffed targets.
Increases Cleanse stacks dealt; after action ends, grants herself Cleanse.
Before battle starts, increases Toughness limit by a percentage and grants equal Toughness.
After taking DMG, consumes Soothe stacks to gain an equal amount of HP.
Based on Soothe stacks, reduces HP Loss received.
After attacking, grants herself Mana but reduces the total DMG percentage dealt.
After casting a skill, cannot be Countered.
Before the turn starts, increases Action Mana for each ally at max Soothe.
